errors.text_span: The chart is divided into 2 main categories and further sub-categories, totaling 18 slices.
errors.evidence: The chart is a multi-level sunburst chart, not a simple pie chart with slices. The description incorrectly represents its structure. The number of 'slices' (segments) is also incorrect; there are more than 18 segments across all levels.

errors.text_span: Under "Abusive", the sub-categories include "Other Negative" (around 17%), "Political Negative" (about 17%), "Racial Negative" (approximately 3%), "Sexist Negative" (around 3%), and "Mixed" (less than 1%).
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly flattens the chart's hierarchy by combining labels from different levels (e.g., the second-level category "Other" and the third-level category "Negative" are merged into "Other Negative"). This misrepresents the nested structure of the sunburst chart.
The description omits the "Religious" sub-category which is present under the main "Abusive" category. It also misses the "Mixed" sub-category under "Racial".

errors.text_span: Under "Not Abusive", the sub-categories are "Other Positive" (around 15%), "Neutral" (approximately 10%)
errors.evidence: This description is structurally incorrect. "Neutral" is not a second-level sub-category under "Not Abusive"; it is a third-level category appearing under "Other," "Political," and "Religious." The label "Other Positive" is also a fabrication that combines two different hierarchical levels.
There is no category or group of slices labeled "Negative, Positive, Mixed, Neutral" in the chart. This appears to be a fabricated entry.
